descriptionChirho: The proper name זַבְדִּי referring to several Israelite men in the Hebrew Bible: (1) grandfather of Achan from the tribe of Judah (Josh 7:1,17-18), (2) a Benjaminite (1 Chr 8:19), (3) overseer of David's wine cellars (1 Chr 27:27), and (4) a Levite (Neh 11:17). All 6 occurrences use this same personal name regardless of whether appearing bare or with conjunction waw ('and Zabdi'). Translated as English 'Zavdi/Zabdi,' Spanish 'Zabdi,' Hindi 'Jabdi' (जब्दी), Arabic 'Zabdi' (زَبْدِي), Korean 'Sapdi' (삽디), Swahili 'Zabdi.'
